# References {.unnumbered}

This page lists the direct software, libraries, and local helper scripts used to build and display this book. It is intended as a practical attribution and reproducibility note, not a full software bill of materials for every transitive dependency bundled by each tool.

## Production tools {.unnumbered}

| Software | Version used locally | Role | License / project |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) | 1.9.37 | Builds the book website and PDF from the `.qmd` source files. | [Open-source Quarto CLI](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli) |
| [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org/) | 3.8.3 | Document conversion engine used by Quarto. | [GPL-2.0-or-later](https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/blob/main/COPYRIGHT) |
| [Typst](https://typst.app/) | 0.14.2 | PDF typesetting backend used by the Quarto `typst` format. | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/main/LICENSE) |

## Website libraries {.unnumbered}

| Software | How it is used | License / project |
|---|---|---|
| [Typed.js](https://github.com/mattboldt/typed.js) 2.1.0 | Loaded from `unpkg.com` for the animated "Beyond the Chatbox" title on the home page. | [MIT](https://github.com/mattboldt/typed.js/blob/v2.1.0/LICENSE.txt) |
| [Bootstrap](https://getbootstrap.com/) and the Cosmo theme | HTML layout, responsive navigation, typography, and theme styling through Quarto. | [MIT](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [Bootstrap Icons](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/) | Icons used in Quarto navigation and controls. | [MIT](https://github.com/twbs/icons/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [Clipboard.js](https://clipboardjs.com/) | Code-copy buttons generated by Quarto. | [MIT](https://github.com/zenorocha/clipboard.js/blob/master/license) |
| [Fuse.js](https://www.fusejs.io/) and autocomplete support | Client-side search generated by Quarto. | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/krisk/Fuse/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [Tippy.js](https://atomiks.github.io/tippyjs/) and [Popper](https://popper.js.org/) | Tooltips and popovers generated by Quarto. | [MIT](https://github.com/atomiks/tippyjs/blob/master/LICENSE), [MIT](https://github.com/floating-ui/floating-ui/blob/master/LICENSE) |
| [AnchorJS](https://www.bryanbraun.com/anchorjs/) | Header anchor links generated by Quarto. | [MIT](https://github.com/bryanbraun/anchorjs/blob/gh-pages/LICENSE) |
| [Headroom.js](https://wicky.nillia.ms/headroom.js/) | Navigation header behavior generated by Quarto. | [MIT](https://github.com/WickyNilliams/headroom.js/blob/master/LICENSE) |

::: {.callout-note title="Typed.js license version"}

This book intentionally pins Typed.js to version 2.1.0, whose release tag includes an MIT license. The current `main` branch of Typed.js uses a GPL-3.0-or-later license. Re-check the upstream license before upgrading the CDN URL to a newer Typed.js release.

:::

## Local project code {.unnumbered}

The book also uses small local scripts and styles maintained in this repository:

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `styles.css` | Custom visual styling, including the Typed.js cursor styling. |
| `scripts/typed-init.js` | Initializes the Typed.js title animation. |
| `scripts/details-fold.js` | Adds behavior for collapsible details blocks. |
| `scripts/trigger-fix.lua` and `scripts/fix-typst-bg.lua` | Support the PDF/Typst rendering workflow. |
| `scripts/analytics.html` | Adds site analytics markup. |
